name: Froga (Maltese Omelet)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 100 g cooked lean beef or 200 g corned beef (optional), chopped very small and fine

steps: Place the mashed potatoes in a bowl and add the spring onions, beef, cheese, the parsley, salt, and pepper. Mix together, then add the eggs and mix everything together.
Heat some oil in a frying pan. Add 3 large spoonfuls of the mixture to the frying pan, and flatten them out to around 1 cm thick. Cook until golden brown.
Serve hot with salad and fresh buttered bread.
